notes:
Debug-signed dev build for sideloading, with the in-app updater; not for Play.

Backend: https://staging-donationengine.g3tech.net (SERVER_URL and APP_ORIGIN compiled in).

This is the first release published to g3techhq/releases. Since the earlier hand-installed dev builds:

- The app now checks this repository for newer dev builds, then downloads, verifies and installs them itself (Update prompt, and an Updates card on About).
- feat(charts): draw the donut, financials and giving trend with g3-charts
- feat(settings): grow a theme change over the page from the click
- feat(db): apply schema changes through a migrate step built on rollouts
